broker.name: ThinkMarkets
broker.tagline: On its own site since 2010. Its site names 9 regulators, including ASIC, FCA, and CySEC. Rules depend on where you live. Advertised leverage: Up to 1:5000.
broker.about: ThinkMarkets says it has operated since 2010. The pages checked do not name one headquarters. Account names on its site include ThinkTrader, Standard, and ThinkZero. Platforms named there include ThinkTrader, MetaTrader 4, MetaTrader 5, and TradingView. The site names these regulators: ASIC, FCA, CySEC, FSCA, FSA (Seychelles), FSC (Mauritius), DFSA, CIMA, and JFSA. The company on an account depends on where the client lives. Minimum deposit is not a single number on the pages that loaded. The highest leverage figure taken from those pages is Up to 1:5000. Leverage increases losses as well as gains.
broker.regulators_note: The company behind an account depends on where you live. ASIC: TF Global Markets (Aust) Pty Ltd, 424700. FCA: TF Global Markets (UK) Limited, 629628. CySEC: TF Global Markets (Europe) Ltd, 215/13. FSCA. FSA (Seychelles). FSC (Mauritius). DFSA. CIMA. JFSA.

broker.costs_note: Spreads and commissions move with the market, and they are not the same at every company in the group.
broker.leverage_note: Leverage increases losses as well as gains, and you can lose more than you deposit. The highest figure on this card is the highest number this broker advertises. It is not the cap on every account. The cap depends on the company, the product and where you live.

other_fees.label: Minimum deposit
other_fees.note: The global help article says first deposits are 10 USD for ThinkTrader, 50 USD for Standard MT4 and MT5, and 100 USD for ThinkZero, or the equivalent in the base currency. The UK broker page says the minimum deposit is 10 GBP. Crypto deposits have a separate 20 USD minimum. Because the figure depends on account and region, no single number is stored.

other_fees.label: UK deposit fee
other_fees.note: UK page says deposit and withdraw in GBP with no deposit fees, through bank transfer, cards and e-wallets.

other_fees.label: Crypto deposit minimum
other_fees.note: Help article says this is a crypto deposit minimum, not the account minimum, and that network fees can reduce the amount received.

_notes.fetch_notes: The bare homepage https://www.thinkmarkets.com first returned a French page. The English page at /en/ loaded. It says established in 2010 and lists offices including Australia, Asia, Europe, the UK, the UAE and South Africa, without naming one headquarters. The about page prints NZFMA as the New Zealand Financial Markets Association. The licences article separately names the Financial Markets Authority (FMA) and does not give a country. Both are recorded because the site prints both names. The about timeline says a JFSA licence was obtained in 2022 and does not give the number. FSCA, Seychelles FSA, Mauritius FSC, DFSA and CIMA are named without licence numbers. UK retail risk warning on the UK page says 75% of retail investor accounts lose money when trading CFDs with this provider.
